content.text: Stay up to date with notifications from The IndependentNotifications can be managed in browser preferences.Not nowYes pleaseSwipe for next articleAllNewsSportCultureLifestyleWhy wasn’t Sean Penn at the Oscars?Copy linkBookmark popoverRemoved from bookmarksClose popover Powered By 10 Sec 17K 0One Battle After Another (Trailer 2)Next video inShareNextKEEP WATCHING One Battle After Another (Trailer 2)Sean Penn won the Oscar for Best Supporting Actor for his performance in One Battle After Another. Penn was not present at the ceremony to accept his award, as presenter Kieran Culkin joked: “Sean Penn couldn’t be here tonight, or didn’t want to so I will take this for him.”Instead of attending the ceremony, Penn took a train to the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv to meet the country’s president, Volodymyr Zelensky, on Monday.Penn has become a close ally of Zelensky following Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, and gave him one of his Oscars as a “symbol of faith” in 2022.Penn previously won two Best Actor awards for his roles in Mystic River and Milk.In fullHow Sean Penn became Zelensky’s closest
